description: This file defines the enum ClientIdentifierStatus, representing different states of a client identifier such as ACTIVE, INACTIVE, and INVALID, and includes utility methods for status conversion and checks.

classes.name: ClientIdentifierStatus
classes.description: Enum representing the status of a client identifier with associated values and codes, and utility methods for status retrieval and checking.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer status value to the corresponding ClientIdentifierStatus enum value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the status.

methods.name: isInactive
methods.description: Checks if the status is INACTIVE.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the status is ACTIVE.
